adjudication.determinism: Hash both the complete TIFF and its uint16 pixel payload. Any disagreement in either hash fails the byte property.
adjudication.memory_peak: Use the maximum observed process-tree private committed bytes over all accepted scored matrix runs.
adjudication.memory_ratio: For each worker count, divide the maximum accepted N=299 peak by the maximum accepted N=33 peak; the maximum worker-specific ratio is the score.
adjudication.memory_sampling: A sampled peak above 6 GiB is a valid one-sided FAIL even if sampling gaps occurred, because missed samples can hide a higher peak but cannot manufacture the observed allocation. A PASS would require every run's maximum sample gap <=100 ms and >=90% scheduled-sample coverage.
adjudication.modulo: Use the minimum accepted warm wall time per N across the six alternating-order scored repetitions, divide by N, then compute (max-min)/min.
adjudication.overall: Any valid hard-gate failure makes M12 FAIL. PASS requires every M12 bar plus the M11 joint requirement. If no bar fails and a required validity/joint term is unavailable, M12 remains UNMEASURED.

host_load_gate.application: Every formal warm-up and scored invocation waits for the preload gate; any invocation crossing the during-run gate is preserved as rejected and repeated in the same position.

source_lines.text:
### 7.3 Timing gate to inherit

1. Sample whole-host busy time for five seconds before each arm; start only at
   `<=15%`.
2. During the arm, subtract **whole-process-tree** CPU from system busy CPU and
   require external busy `<=10%` of wall time times 32 logical processors.
   Anything above that is invalid and must not enter a minimum, median, or
   ratio.
3. Alternate arm/sweep order. Retry a rejected paired position as a pair;
   never splice a favourable loaded half into a clean comparison.
4. Record executable and input provenance, QPC wall time, process-tree CPU,
   system/external busy, peak memory, bytes read/written, stage banners, full
   output hash, and a nonzero decoded-output witness.
